verdict.rationale: Xero documents its own automatic detection and flagging of duplicate bills, which covers the duplicate-transaction part of the story, and JAX is described as an AI agent that categorizes and matches transactions during reconciliation. Nothing shows an agent continuously monitoring the ledger for spend anomalies or running pre-close checks. The MCP server and APIs are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: spend-anomaly detection, agent-driven continuous ledger monitoring, pre-close anomaly review workflow, duplicate detection beyond bills (e.g. bank or ledger transactions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: Detect and flag duplicate bills automatically to minimize fraud and payment errors
